inspection_definitions.full-safe-text-static: Entire safe repository-owned text was read; application code was never imported or executed.
inspection_definitions.manual-runtime-source-static: Entire test or operational script was read as text; its network, evaluation, runtime, database, provider or destructive operations were not performed.
inspection_definitions.generated-integrity-text: Dependency checksum text read and classified, preserved unchanged; hashes are not copied into reports.
inspection_definitions.static-template-asset: Entire HTML template read as safe static text; embedded external assets were not fetched.
inspection_definitions.configuration-template: Checked-in example configuration only, not actual environment, secrets or credentials.
